snippet.title: Heartworm Coming to Consoles | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Heartworm is coming to consoles on October 1st!

Step into a world where memories and mourning blur the lines between reality and supernatural visions in this atmospheric survival horror game from the mind of developer Vincent Adinolfi. 

Enter the house. Face the demons. Uncover the truth that these mountains hide. 

Follow Vincent: https://x.com/adinolfi
